mission.title: Our Mission
mission.desc: To deliver reliable grading, cold storage, and scheduled produce supply that our commercial partners can count on daily.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.desc: To maintain a dependable domestic supply base for fresh fruits and vegetables covering client demand across all seasons.

ambition.title: Our Ambition
ambition.desc: To support Saudi Vision 2030 food security goals as a primary fresh-produce supplier for grocery delivery platforms and retailers across the Kingdom and GCC.

journey.title: Four Stages From Farm to Market

step1.title: Harvest & Reception
step1.desc: Working with 35 local farms to receive crops at optimal ripeness.

step2.title: Grading & Packing
step2.desc: Trained teams grade and pack each batch under strict food-safety controls.

step3.title: Cold Storage & Staging
step3.desc: Temperature-controlled warehouses hold freshness and stage orders on ready pallets.
step3.alt: Quality control specialists in cold storage

step4.title: Refrigerated Dispatch
step4.desc: 15+ refrigerated trucks deliver orders on schedule without breaking the cold chain.
